name.zh: 主持人让位与数据接管

description.zh: 主持人先设问，再缩为圆形小窗，让正负趋势图接管主画面；源视频时钟连续，最后聚焦关键季度。
description.en: A presenter poses a question, shrinks into a circular inset, and hands the frame to a signed trend chart with a retained focal period.

description.zh: 先用醒目数字建立反差，再逐项累积正负贡献；起点、变化与终点来自同一账本，可核对而不是只做视觉隐喻。
description.en: A bold hook leads into a signed contribution bridge, with a computed endpoint and a checkable shared scale.

description.zh: 保留分层板和已出现对象，按明确阈值移动更新对象；支持改善与回落，不把主观档位伪装成数值排名。
description.en: Keep a tier board alive as evidence changes. Entities move according to explicit thresholds, supporting improvements and declines.

name.zh: 角色主持与透视数据板

description.zh: 猫或自定义角色主持，搭配稳定的倾斜透视数据板，按设问、逐项证据、结论推进。附家庭账本与物流两组可替换示例。
description.en: A cat or custom presenter with a stable perspective data board: question, staged evidence, takeaway. Includes household and logistics datasets.

description.zh: 独立设计的 9:16 榜单故事：先设问，再逐项揭晓，最后保留领先结论。为手机留出右侧操作区与底部字幕区。
description.en: A purpose-built 9:16 ranking story: hook, staged countdown, and a retained takeaway, with space reserved for mobile controls and captions.

description.zh: 主持人图片区与数据板分区呈现，按讲解节拍逐项展示、强调和归纳。可替换主持人图片或视频。
description.en: A presenter image or video alongside a data board, with timed evidence reveals, emphasis, and a final takeaway.

description.zh: 先观看连续实景视频，再引入稳定数据区，依次展示同尺度指标和结论。短素材末帧停留，不循环。
description.en: Establish continuous footage, then introduce a stable evidence area with shared-scale metrics and a takeaway. Short clips hold their final frame.

description.zh: 从末位逐项揭晓排名，已出现的对象持续保留，数值与条长来自同一数据，最后强调领先差距。
description.en: Reveal a ranking from bottom to top, preserve settled rows, and close on the leading margin. Values and bars share one data source.

description.zh: 面向多实体时序排名的连续竞赛图，支持数值插值、动态换位、进入退出和稳定实体配色。
description.en: A continuous race for multi-entity time series with value interpolation, rank transitions, entry and exit, and stable entity colors.

description.zh: 把排名变化组织成问题、追踪对象、转折旁注和最终主张，适合证据导向的编辑化数据故事。
description.en: Turn ranking change into an editorial story with a question, tracked entity, turning-point note, and final claim.

description.zh: 用暗色赛道、领先者聚光和一次关键超越冲击聚焦，把排名变化变成高能竞赛段落。
description.en: Use dark lanes, a leader spotlight, and one crash focus on the pivotal overtake for a high-energy race sequence.

description.zh: 把可编辑的百分比液位、标签和来源放入实景负空间，同时保留主体避让与清晰阅读层级。
description.en: Place an editable percentage vessel, labels, and source in contextual negative space while preserving focal clearance and readability.

description.zh: 用连续排名轨迹揭示超越、反转与格局变化，保留每个时期的原始数值与稳定实体颜色。
description.en: Reveal overtakes, reversals, and rank changes with continuous trajectories, source values, and stable entity colors.

description.zh: 沿趋势扫描并在关键异常停留放大，把“看见走势”和“解释异常”组织成同一个动态图表镜头。
description.en: Scan a trend and magnify the key anomaly, combining overview and focused explanation in one data shot.

description.zh: 把原始表格、结构转换和可视化结论放在一个可追溯的解释镜头中，适合方法说明与数据来源交代。
description.en: Connect source rows, transformation, and the visual conclusion in a traceable explanatory shot.

description.zh: 将地区指标映射到真实地理边界，并同步显示排名、数值、来源和可编辑的颜色尺度。
description.en: Map regional metrics to real geographic boundaries with synchronized ranking, values, source, and an editable color scale.

description.zh: 按叙事顺序绘制跨地区大圆路径，同时累积每条流向的结构化数值，适合贸易、迁移和供应链故事。
description.en: Draw geographic great-circle routes in narrative order while accumulating structured values for trade, migration, or supply-chain stories.

description.zh: 先建立完整趋势，再用缓慢推镜靠近异常节点；镜头只调度注意力，不改变图表数据几何。
description.en: Establish the full trend, then slowly push toward an anomaly without changing the chart geometry.

description.zh: 镜头沿多个数据时期逐段巡航，在每个里程碑留出阅读停顿，并在结论节点减速停稳。
description.en: Travel milestone by milestone with reading pauses, then brake smoothly into the final conclusion.

description.zh: 从一个关键数据柱的近景拉升到完整比较结构，让局部发现自然过渡为全局解释。
description.en: Rise from one key data bar into the full comparison structure, moving from detail to system.

description.zh: 让环境、空间底图和数据节点以克制的速度差滑行，建立地理数据的层次与方向感。
description.en: Glide environment, spatial base, and data markers at restrained relative speeds for geographic depth.

description.zh: 先呈现完整群体，再拉远并暗化邻项，把异常对象从平均结构中清晰分离。
description.en: Show the cohort, then pull back and dim neighbors to isolate the true outlier.

description.zh: 把同一指标放回两个程序化情境中比较，让数值差异与真实使用语境同时可读。
description.en: Compare one metric across two programmatic contexts so the numeric difference retains real-world meaning.

description.zh: 根据主体保护区和安全区域自动寻找图表停靠位置，避免覆盖实景视觉主体。
description.en: Resolve a chart dock from focal and safe regions without covering the contextual subject.

description.zh: 从程序化原稿和表格中扫描字段，再重构为可编辑图表，保留数据来源与映射关系。
description.en: Scan a source table and reconstruct it as editable marks while preserving provenance and field mappings.

description.zh: 程序化主持人轮廓与可编辑图表分区协作，按照讲解节拍切换注意力和结论。
description.en: Coordinate a programmatic presenter silhouette with an editable chart and narrative beats.

description.zh: 让同一个数据对象从完整比较跨入结论场景，保持数值、标签和颜色身份连续。
description.en: Carry one data object from evidence to conclusion while preserving value, label, and visual identity.

description.zh: 把主题、分类数据与结论直接编译为问题、情境、证据和结论四个连续镜头，并输出可渲染项目数据。
description.en: Compile a topic, categorical data, and takeaway into four continuous question, context, evidence, and conclusion shots.

description.zh: 以 Agnes 生成的连续 MP4 为主要情境层，将指标放入视频负空间并同步冻结结论，避免图表遮挡现场主体。
description.en: Use a continuous Agnes-generated MP4 as the context layer and place synchronized metrics in protected negative space.

description.zh: 用可编辑关键帧持续指向 Agnes 生成视频中的设备、人物或产品，同时保持标题与结论稳定。
description.en: Track a device, person, or product in Agnes-generated footage with editable keyframes while keeping titles and takeaways stable.

description.zh: 适合条形图场景，以“基础条形图”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。
description.en: Use the original simple bar chart implementation for single-metric category comparisons.

runtime.name: Basic Bar Chart
runtime.suggestedNarration: By Jun, the category reaches 205K.
runtime.animationIntent: Highlight the named column and its value.

description.zh: 适合折线图场景，以“基础折线图”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。
description.en: Use the original simple line chart implementation for a single ordered time series.

runtime.name: Basic Line Chart
runtime.suggestedNarration: By Aug, the trend reaches 241K.
runtime.animationIntent: Highlight the named point when the narration names it.

description.zh: 适合占比图场景，以“基础饼图”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。
description.en: Use the original simple pie/donut implementation for part-to-whole distributions.

runtime.name: Basic Pie Chart
runtime.suggestedNarration: Enterprise owns the largest share at 42 percent.
runtime.animationIntent: Highlight the named slice and legend row.

description.zh: 适合指标卡场景，以“基础指标卡片”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。
description.en: Use the original compact stat-card layout for 2-4 key metrics or a single hero metric.

runtime.name: Basic Stat Cards
runtime.suggestedNarration: Revenue is the metric to watch at 241K.
runtime.animationIntent: Highlight the named KPI card and value.

runtime.suggestedNarration: An editorial title introduces the key business question.
runtime.animationIntent: Reveal the editorial title and accent rule.

description.zh: 适合开场与结尾场景，以“开场商务简报”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

runtime.name: Executive Brief Opening

description.zh: 适合开场与结尾场景，以“开场数据网格”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

description.zh: 适合开场与结尾场景，以“开场分屏指标”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

description.zh: 适合开场与结尾场景，以“开场电影感大标题”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

runtime.name: Cinematic Headline Opening

runtime.animationIntent: Use a cinematic headline entrance with restrained supporting copy.

description.zh: 适合指标卡场景，以“核心数字聚焦”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

description.zh: 适合指标卡场景，以“关键指标微型仪表盘”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

runtime.name: KPI Micro Dashboard

runtime.name: Stat Cards KPI Trio
runtime.suggestedNarration: Revenue is the headline KPI at 241K.

runtime.name: Quarterly Revenue Grouped Bar
runtime.suggestedNarration: Q4 shows the clearest revenue and cost separation.
runtime.animationIntent: Highlight the named comparison group.

runtime.name: Coffee Rating Horizontal Ranking

description.zh: 适合条形图场景，以“部门人数深色条形图”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

runtime.name: Executive Horizontal Bars
runtime.suggestedNarration: By August, revenue leads the ranking at 241K.
runtime.animationIntent: Focus the leading ranked row when the narration names it.

description.zh: 适合条形图场景，以“紧凑柱状图关键指标”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。
description.en: Use a compact dark column chart with a small KPI badge and clean category comparison.

runtime.name: Compact Column KPI

runtime.animationIntent: Mark the named column and its value label.

description.zh: 适合折线图场景，以“利润率斜率对比”组织数据并保持可编辑的数据映射。

runtime.animationIntent: Spotlight the named point and keep the summary panel stable.

runtime.name: Editorial Data Story

runtime.name: Dark Signal Trendline

runtime.name: Dual Series Pulse Line
